reviewer: Claude coordinator and independent Claude review agents (text, illustrations)
text: Independent review agent read the full text against Ryder's The Old Man with the Young Wife (Book III) and its frame; the frame (the owl counsellor Flame-Eye to King Foe-Crusher) is stated correctly, and the omitted verses and every added detail are disclosed.

Age band 16+, shelved in the adults' library section: the bought marriage is made explicit through the money bag, the line that nobody asked the daughter, and a discussion question, without moralising.

Ryder's 'hugs me to her breast' and 'passionately cling' become holding him tight; nothing sexual; the content note is accurate (nobody hurt, nothing stolen). After review the wife is consistently described as a grown woman and the Kannada content note reads more naturally.
The source has no caste label and the changes say so. The pause question comes before the reveal; no em dashes.

2026-10-08: the coordinator moved this story from the collection slug doddavara-kathegalu to chitrakathe (the section was renamed ಚಿತ್ರಕಥೆ); only the collection and image path fields changed, the text and art are unchanged.
illustrations: Storyboard 1024x1536, 262 KB; seams at x=512 and y=512/1024; painted to all edges with no text. One generation and one whole-sheet edit that made the thief's sack empty, matching 'nothing stolen'.
Panels 4 to 6 show the fully clothed wife gripping the old man's arm with a frightened face, which reads as fear, not romance; the blanket stays at waist level.
No caste markers, similar skin tones, no modern objects; a temple tower in panel 1's background shows no deity.
limitations: AI-agent editorial review, not human Kannada-teacher or scholar certification.
Age bands are editorial judgements against the README table and have not been tested with children, parents or adult readers.
Source fidelity was checked against saved copies of the Wikisource pages of Ryder's 1925 translation, not against Durgasimha's Kannada text or a Sanskrit recension.
Art was generated with Codex CLI on gpt-5.6-sol and judged on the full sheet and 512px panel crops with the grid measured in pixels, not in the app in dark mode.
